**Key findings:** Megève has no public IT/tech conference calendar. The town's value for tech professionals is exclusively as a luxury **corporate retreat venue** — 2,000 m² congress hall, 15+ seminar spaces, MICE coordination — used for private company off-sites. The only notable public professional event is [Megève Leadership](https://www.megeveleadership.com/) (leadership/entrepreneurship focus, no IT content; next edition March 2027). Nearest recurring public tech events are Mountain Planet in Grenoble (~1.5 h, biennial ski industry tech), Black Alps cybersecurity conference near Lausanne (~1.5 h, November), and Alpine Tech Forum in Zurich/Davos (~2 h).
